preserve_user_count.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS user_count FROM public."User"

preserve_sms_count.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS sms_count FROM public."SmsMessage"

preserve_voicemail_count.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS voicemail_count FROM public."Voicemail"

sms_legacy_read_backfill.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS missing_read_receipt FROM public."SmsMessage" AS message JOIN public."SmsThread" AS thread ON thread.id = message."threadId" WHERE message.direction = 'in' AND thread."lastReadAt" IS NOT NULL AND message."createdAt" <= thread."lastReadAt" AND (to_jsonb(message)->>'readAt') IS NULL

voicemail_outbox_exists.sql: SELECT to_regclass('public."VoicemailEmailDelivery"') IS NOT NULL AS outbox_exists
